about: Dawson Law Group works from Taylor Street in Portland with a second office in West Linn, and says it takes serious injury and wrongful death cases on a contingency fee.
Its Google listings average a flat five stars across 122 reviews. It names no attorney on the pages we could reach and publishes no case results we could read.
